domain.finite_probe_effect_family: finite SIC-effect local responses seeded by torch-native spinor-derived carrier data

chosen_finite_map_artifact.PEPS3D_anchor_requirement: Each admitted row must preserve explicit site, edge, face, and cell anchors for omega_012 plus boundary/interior and cut-edge incidence. No scalar carrier labels are admitted.
